title: Chapter 7 Statement of Your Current Monthly Income
notes: The CMI statement (issue #102): every income line is a projection of the § 101(10A) derivation (core/cmi.py) over the case's dated income history — the one place the model deliberately refuses to mirror the form (case-data-model.md). Known defects of the official PDF, verified by widget geometry: Debtor 2's line-4 box is named Debto2.Quest2.2; line 12a's copy box has no widget; line 10's two source boxes are ordinary distinct fields (suffixes 1/2) despite their prose-length names.
